Agent Name: BingAPI_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In Step 1, BingAPI_Expert asserted a “Confirmed Accessibility” list (including O’Jung’s Tavern Bar) without providing verification or sources. Subsequent steps relied on this unverified claim, leading to the selection of O’Jung’s as the closest “wheelchair accessible” bar. Because the core constraint was wheelchair accessibility and it was not actually verified, this early, unsupported confirmation directly risks producing a wrong final answer.
